page.overview:
Who is Jonas Grumby?

Captain Jonas Grumby was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, he was the commander of the . Sometime in that year, he received an order about STFL Cargo Manifest 045-349374 from Commander Seth Shostak of Terrestrial Defense Division. His name, rank, and current assignment was from the order's heading. (, okudagram)
